en.topic_title: Research schooner Tara sets sail from Hong Kong on 18-month mission to unlock coral resilience secrets
en.topic_summary:
Docked at Central Pier No. 10, under the glow of the Hong Kong skyline, the research ship Tara presented an unlikely sight earlier this month. Its round aluminium hull was built to withstand the crushing pressure of polar ice, popping up like an olive pit pinched between thumb and forefinger then drifting with the pack until the warming temperatures loosened its icy grip.
